# Load in all necessary packages
```{r}
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(sesame)
library(sesameData)
library(limma)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
query <- GDCquery(project = "TCGA-BRCA",
                  data.category = "DNA Methylation",
                  data.type = "Methylation Beta Value",
                  platform = "Illumina Human Methylation 450",
                  data.format = "Dataframe")
   GDCdownload(query, method = "api", files.per.chunk = 10)
   methylation450 <- GDCprepare(query)
```

```{r}
methylation_clinical <- as.data.frame(methylation450@colData)
betas <- as.data.frame(methylation450@assays@data@listData) #takes a longer time
cpg_sites <- as.data.frame(methylation450@rowRanges@elementMetadata)

column_mask <- ifelse(colnames(methylation_clinical) %in% c('treatments', 'primary_site', 'disease_type','sites_of_involvement'), F, T)

methylation_clinical <- methylation_clinical[,column_mask]
write.csv(methylation_clinical, 'brca_methylation_clinical.csv')


site_mask <- !grepl('-', cpg_sites$gene) & !grepl(';', cpg_sites$gene) & !is.na(cpg_sites$gene) & complete.cases(betas)
betas <- betas[site_mask,]
cpg_sites <- cpg_sites[site_mask,]

write.csv(betas, 'brca_methylation_betas.csv') #takes a longer time
write.csv(cpg_sites, 'brca_cpg_sites.csv')
```

```{r}
meth_mask <- methylation_clinical$definition %in% c("Metastatic", "Primary solid Tumor")
methylation_clinical <- methylation_clinical[meth_mask,]
betas_clean <- betas[,meth_mask]

#creating our variable of interest & deciding the base group
methylation_clinical$metastasis_category <- ifelse(methylation_clinical$definition == "Metastatic", "metastatic", "non_metastatic")

#define your comparison and base group
non_metastatic_mask <- methylation_clinical$metastasis_category == "non_metastatic"
methylation_clinical$metastatic <- !non_metastatic_mask #metastatic is comparison, non-metastatic is base

#fitting linear models using a "target value"
mval <- t(apply(betas_clean, 1, function(x) {x <- pmin(pmax(x, 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6); log2(x/(1-x))}))


design <- model.matrix(~ metastatic, data = methylation_clinical)
fit <- lmFit(mval, design)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit)
```

```{r}
# Extracting model into dataframe
dat <- data.frame(foldchange = fit[["coefficients"]][,2], logPvalue =  -log10(p.adjust(fit2[["p.value"]][,2],method='BY')), geneName = cpg_sites$gene)
dat$threshold <- as.factor(abs(dat$foldchange) < 1)

# Visualization
cols <- c("TRUE" = "grey", "FALSE" = "blue")
ggplot(data=dat, aes(x=foldchange, y = logPvalue, colour = threshold)) +
  geom_point(alpha=.2, size=0.6) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cols) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, colour="#990000", linetype="dashed") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = - 1, colour="#990000", linetype="dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2, colour = "#990000", linetype="dashed") +
  theme(legend.position="none") +
  xlab("Fold Change") +
  ylab("-log10 p value") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Saving results to a .csv file
write.csv(dat, "methylation_results_metastasis.csv")
```
# plot analysis
#From the volcano plot we can see that most CpG sites don’t differ significantly in methylation between the metastatic and non-metastatic groups. Among the sites, there was far more hypomethylated than hypermethylated in metastatic samples. In this dataset, a small set of CpG sites show altered methylation in metastatic samples with an overall trend towards loss of methylation. We are therefore unable to conclude these methylation changes cause metastasis. The metastatic samples come from different body sites and the groupings are very small. comparing only 5 metastatic samples with 793 non-metastatic samples.

#(2) Direct comparison of methylation status to transcriptional activity
```{r}
rm(mval); gc()   # free memory

rna_query <- GDCquery(project = "TCGA-BRCA",
                      data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
                      data.type = "Gene Expression Quantification",
                      workflow.type = "STAR - Counts",
                      sample.type = c("Primary Tumor", "Metastatic"))
GDCdownload(rna_query, method = "api", files.per.chunk = 20)
rna_se <- GDCprepare(rna_query)

rna_clinical <- as.data.frame(rna_se@colData)
rna_clinical <- rna_clinical[, !sapply(rna_clinical, is.list)]
rna_genes <- as.data.frame(rna_se@rowRanges@elementMetadata)
rna_counts <- as.data.frame(rna_se@assays@data$unstranded)
colnames(rna_counts) <- rna_clinical$barcode
rownames(rna_counts) <- rna_genes$gene_id

write.csv(rna_clinical, "brca_rna_clinical_data.csv")
write.csv(rna_genes, "brca_rna_gene_data.csv")
write.csv(rna_counts, "brca_rna_count_data.csv")

rm(rna_se); gc()
```
```{r}
if (!require("DESeq2", quietly = TRUE)) BiocManager::install("DESeq2")
library(DESeq2)

rna_clinical <- read.csv("brca_rna_clinical_data.csv", row.names = 1)
rna_genes <- read.csv("brca_rna_gene_data.csv")
rna_counts <- read.csv("brca_rna_count_data.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

# match RNA samples to methylation samples using the "sample" column
rna_clinical <- rna_clinical[rna_clinical$sample %in% methylation_clinical$sample, ]
rna_clinical <- rna_clinical[!duplicated(rna_clinical$sample), ]

# metastasis status from the methylation clinical data
rna_clinical$metastatic <- methylation_clinical$metastatic[match(rna_clinical$sample, methylation_clinical$sample)]
rna_clinical$metastasis_status <- factor(ifelse(rna_clinical$metastatic, "metastatic", "non_metastatic"),
                                         levels = c("non_metastatic", "metastatic"))
table(rna_clinical$metastasis_status)

rownames(rna_clinical) <- rna_clinical$barcode
rna_counts <- rna_counts[, rna_clinical$barcode]

# filter out genes with total expression < 20
keep_genes <- rowSums(rna_counts) >= 20
rna_counts <- rna_counts[keep_genes, ]
rna_genes <- rna_genes[keep_genes, ]

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = rna_counts, colData = rna_clinical,
                              design = ~ metastasis_status)
dds <- DESeq(dds)   # takes a while

results <- results(dds, contrast = c("metastasis_status", "metastatic", "non_metastatic"))
results <- data.frame(results)
results$gene_name <- rna_genes$gene_name
write.csv(results, "deseq_results_metastasis.csv")

de_results <- read.csv("deseq_results_metastasis.csv")
```
```{r}
# Extract genes of interest
downregulated <- de_results[which(de_results$padj < 0.05 & de_results$log2FoldChange < -1), 'gene_name']
hypermethylated <- dat[dat$foldchange > 1, 'geneName'] # cutoff of 1 matches the volcano plot lines
interest_genes <- intersect(downregulated, hypermethylated)
interest_genes
```
```{r}
# Explore your gene of interest
GENE <- "VDR"

gene_counts_mask <- rna_genes$gene_name == GENE
gene_betas_mask <- cpg_sites$gene == GENE

# Making TRUE/FALSE masks for metastatic vs non-metastatic samples in both the RNA and methylation data
rna_clinical_metastatic <- rna_clinical$metastatic
methylation_clinical_metastatic <- methylation_clinical$metastatic

rna_clinical_non_metastatic <- !rna_clinical$metastatic
methylation_clinical_non_metastatic <- !methylation_clinical$metastatic

# Pulling out this gene's RNA counts and CpG beta values for each group
rna_metastatic <- as.numeric(rna_counts[gene_counts_mask, rna_clinical_metastatic])
methylation_metastatic <- (betas_clean[gene_betas_mask, methylation_clinical_metastatic, drop = FALSE])

rna_non_metastatic <- as.numeric(rna_counts[gene_counts_mask, rna_clinical_non_metastatic])
methylation_non_metastatic <- (betas_clean[gene_betas_mask, methylation_clinical_non_metastatic, drop = FALSE])
```
```{r}
boxplot(rna_non_metastatic, rna_metastatic, xlab='Group', ylab='Counts', names=c('non-metastatic', 'metastatic'),
        col=c("blue","red"), main = GENE)
```
```{r}
plot(1:dim(methylation_non_metastatic)[1], apply(methylation_non_metastatic, 1, mean), col='blue', type='h', lwd=3, ylab='Average Beta', xlab='CpG sites', main = GENE)

lines(1.3:(dim(methylation_metastatic)[1]+0.3), apply(methylation_metastatic, 1, mean), col='red', type='h', lwd=3)

legend("topright",
       legend=c("Non-metastatic", "Metastatic"),
       col=c("blue", "red"),
       lwd=3,
       cex=0.7)
```
#Graph analysis
#The box plot shows that VDR expression is lower in metastatic samples than non-metastatic samples and the methylation plot shows that metastic samples ahve a higher average methylation at most VDR CpG sites. We can see this in sites 4 and 5. Lower expression and higher methylation in metastic group gives us the general idea that that methylation may be able to silence VDR. However, we are only able to assume correlation and not a set conclusion because there are only 5 metastic samples. We also don’t know whether these CpG sites are in VDR’s promoter so we can’t be sure methylation is the reason VDR is lower.
